sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:8

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:8:1
items.html: The NHY of Ima need to empty of her lights, so that immediately after the birth the Mochin of ZA may enter within them: Meaning, that they need to diminish in accordance with the smallness of ZA, as above, so that the lights of greatness that are in Tevuna must necessarily depart from them, for they are not suited to ZA, and how could they clothe within him? As the ARI wrote above, page 949, item 154 — see there.
